Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

| | Rate of subscription | Amount of Insurance Cover | Before enrolment member as | After enrolment a member | |
| 'C' | ~ | ~ | ~ | ~ | ~ |
| | 20 | 20,000 | 10 | 30 | 30,000 |
| *'D' | 10 | 10,000 | 5 | 15 | 15,000 |  
* The rate of subscription to the erstwhile Group 'D' employees placed in PB-1 with Grade Pay of t 1,800 and classified as Group 'C' is at t 30 per month from January, 2011 onwards.  
- GIO (1), Para. 5.4.
